annotation.title_clean: ISO/IEC 5259-5:2025 - Artificial intelligence — Data quality for analytics and machine learning (ML) — Part 5: Data quality governance framework
annotation.title_en: ISO/IEC 5259-5:2025 - Artificial intelligence — Data quality for analytics and machine learning (ML) — Part 5: Data quality governance framework
annotation.summary_en: ISO store page for ISO/IEC 5259-5:2025, a published international standard giving a governance framework for data quality in analytics and machine learning. It helps governing bodies and senior management direct and monitor data quality across the data life cycle. It has no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Provides a governance-level framework for overseeing data quality in analytics and ML.
Targets governing bodies and senior management, defining the 'why' and 'who' rather than the 'how'.
Aligns data quality efforts with organisational strategy and defines responsibilities across the data life cycle.
Complements ISO/IEC 5259-3 and 5259-4 on management and operational processes.
